description: enables the default permissions plus the exit-flow commands, the macOS privacy-permission commands, opening the app's notification settings in the system's settings app, the menu labels, the menu bar icon's menu, raising the window for the exit confirmation, the run-in-background choice, the Dock badge, system notifications, reading and writing clipboard text, saving and opening the configuration file and choosing a directory in the system's dialogs, checking for and installing a new version, opening a link in the system's browser, native window theming, revealing the window the shell creates hidden, and dragging and zooming it by the UI's own top bar
